qualified_claims: The actual RibaMod route populates the Ribasim basin.infiltration pointer before the real update_until call.
The direct BMI injection and actual RibaMod route are identical at reported precision for the 6-hour physical response and the recorded t=0 UserDemand allocation.
Positive basin.infiltration is physically effective in v2026.1.1: it produces material cumulative infiltration and changes the accepted Basin state.

Therefore DUMMY-20H is not caused by an additional RibaMod pointer-timing/composition seam; it is release-native behavior of the bundled Ribasim allocation/physical composition for this topology.
